unsupported_claims.claim: After gaining hand control, Ermes immediately brought Dave Chaffee back to the center with a couple of surges.
Ermes Gasparini secured hand control, brought Dave Chaffee back to the center, got behind his shoulder, planted his elbow, and pressed him to the pad for a win.
Dave Chaffee slid his elbow off the pad by 3-4 inches to avoid a pin from Ermes's flop press, forcing a restart.
Beating Dave Chaffee in the first couple of rounds is considered a big deal, solidifying Ermes Gasparini as a top arm wrestler, potentially number two in the world.
